events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — As the last one on the ice, Joey Daccord skated in a circle with his goalie stick in the air and the home fans chanting his name in unison.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joey Daccord posts second career shutout as Seattle topples Vegas 3-0 in Winter Classic

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Andrei Svechnikov scored twice and Pyotr Kochetkov made 28 saves as the Carolina Hurricanes beat the New York Rangers 6-1 on Tuesday for their fourth-straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Svechnikov scores twice as Hurricanes rout Rangers 6-1

events.name: Boston Bruins at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — James van Riemsdyk scored on a power play and added two assists, lifting the Boston Bruins over the Columbus Blue Jackets 4-1 on Tuesday night and extending their win streak to four games.
headlines.shortLinkText: James van Riemsdyk has a goal, 2 assists to lead Bruins over Blue Jackets 4-1

events.name: Washington Capitals at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — Alex Ovechkin scored a power-play goal during Washington’s fast start, and the Capitals beat Sidney Crosby and the Pittsburgh Penguins 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ovechkin scores as Washington uses fast start to beat Crosby and Penguins 4-3

events.name: Chicago Blackhawks at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Gustav Nyquist and Ryan O’Reilly each had a goal and an assist, Juuse Saros made 21 saves and the Nashville Predators beat the Chicago Blackhawks 3-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Predators blank Blackhawks 3-0 behind Nyquist, O'Reilly, Saros

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Kaiden Guhle and Jordan Harris added to Montreal’s NHL-leading 30 goals from defensemen and Sam Montembeault stopped 30 shots as the Canadiens held off the Dallas Stars 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guhle, Harris lead the way as Canadiens cool off Stars 4-3

events.name: Calgary Flames at Minnesota Wild

headlines.description: — Andrew Mangiapane and Jonathan Huberdeau scored first-period goals for Calgary, and Blake Coleman added an empty-netter as the Flames held on to beat the short-handed Minnesota Wild 3-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mangiapane, Huberdeau score as Flames beat Wild 3-1

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Nikolaj Ehlers and Morgan Barron scored in the third period, and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-2 on Tuesday night to extend their point streak to nine games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikolaj Ehlers scores in the third period as the Winnipeg Jets top the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-2

events.name: New York Islanders at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored a power-play goal 32 seconds into overtime, and the Colorado Avalanche rallied to beat the New York Islanders 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon scores in OT as Avalanche rally to beat Islanders 5-4

events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid had a goal and four assists, and the Edmonton Oilers extended their win streak to six games with a 5-2 victory over the Philadelphia Flyers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor McDavid stars as the Edmonton Oilers beat the Philadelphia Flyers 5-2 for 6th straight win

events.name: Florida Panthers at Arizona Coyotes

headlines.description: — Sam Reinhart and Matthew Tkachuk scored 42 seconds apart in the third period and the Florida Panthers beat the Arizona Coyotes 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reinhart, Tkachuk score late; Florida Panthers win fifth straight 4-1 over the Arizona Coyotes

events.name: Ottawa Senators at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Elias Pettersson and Pius Suter each scored twice, and the Vancouver Canucks used a fast start to beat the Ottawa Senators 6-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elias Pettersson and Pius Suter power the Vancouver Canucks past the Ottawa Senators 6-3

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Martin Jones made 31 saves for his 30th career shutout, William Nylander scored two goals and the Toronto Maple Leafs snapped their three-game losing streak with a 3-0 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Martin Jones posts 2nd shutout of season, Maple Leafs snap 3-game skid with 3-0 win over LA Kings

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — David Perron scored the tying and go-ahead goals in the third period, including the winner with 1:30 left, and the Detroit Red Wings beat San Jose 5-3 on Tuesday night to push the Sharks’ losing streak to nine games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Perron scores twice as Red Wings win 5-3 to hand Sharks their 9th straight loss

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Less than a minute after the Washington Capitals tied the score late in the second period, Michael McLeod delivered a hit to force a turnover and skated directly to the net.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hischier, Mercer and McLeod each score 2 goals as the Devils beat the Capitals 6-3

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Auston Matthews scored 2:12 into overtime and the Toronto Maple Leafs rallied for a 2-1 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Wednesday night, squeaking by after taking 57 shots on goal.
headlines.shortLinkText: Auston Matthews scores in OT as Maple Leafs edge Ducks 2-1

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Sidney Crosby scored on the power play to snap a third-period tie and added two assists, lifting the Pittsburgh Penguins to a 6-5 win over the Boston Bruins on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crosby's power-play goal in 3rd period sends Penguins to 6-5 win over Bruins

events.name: Buffalo Sabres at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Buffalo rookie Devon Levi made 32 saves in his first game at hometown Bell Centre to help the Sabres beat the Montreal Canadiens 6-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Levi makes 32 saves in first game at hometown Bell Centre in Sabres' 6-1 win over Canadiens

events.name: Chicago Blackhawks at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Artemi Panarin scored his team-best 24th goal, Vincent Trocheck added three assists and the New York Rangers defeated the Chicago Blackhawks 4-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panarin scores, Trocheck adds 3 assists as Rangers down Blackhawks 4-1

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Johnny Gaudreau scored in the shootout, Damon Severson and Jake Bean netted goals in the third period and the Columbus Blue Jackets came back to defeat the Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnny Gaudreau's shootout goal lifts Blue Jackets over Flyers 3-2

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Robert Thomas had a goal and an assist to lead the St. Louis Blues over the Vancouver Canucks 2-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thomas scores in 3rd period to give the Blues a 2-1 win over the Canucks

events.name: Calgary Flames at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Connor Zary, Blake Coleman, Rasmus Andersson and Yegor Sharangovich each had a goal and an assist in the Calgary Flames’ 6-3 victory over the Nashville Predators on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flames score 4 goals in 1st, beat Predators 6-3 for 3rd straight win

events.name: Colorado Avalanche at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored his second goal at 3:40 of overtime as the Colorado Avalanche rallied from a pair of two-goal deficits to beat the Dallas Stars 5-4 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nathan MacKinnon scores in OT as Avalanche rally past Stars 5-4

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Minnesota Wild
New York Islanders at Arizona Coyotes

headlines.description: — Bo Horvat scored twice, the second in New York’s three-goal third period, and Ilya Sorokin made 25 saves to help the Islanders beat the Arizona Coyotes 5-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Horvat scores twice, Ilya Sorokin makes 24 saves in Islanders' 5-1 win over Coyotes
